SEL Level 2 · Reading Others: Face Clues

Learn

New Unit: Social

Awareness

Social awareness means noticing how

other people feel.

Reading the room means noticing cues.

Clues help me know how to be kind.

Project

Notebook: Page 1

1. Make your notebook cover. Write your

name.

2. Page 1: draw a face or pick a face card.

3. Write the clue: eyes, eyebrows, or mouth.

4. Write: “I think they feel ___ because

___.”
